title: EFC-C v2.1: Degree-Heterogeneity Entropy-Gradient Predictions for Cognitive States
description: Revision of the EFC-C framework re-anchoring entropy-gradient predictions from the Fiedler eigenvalue to hub-to-periphery degree heterogeneity. Introduces a one-parameter power-law κ = C_eff · D_ratio^γ with γ ≈ 0.55 and separates predictions into Layer A (topological, invariant) and Layer B (absolute-scale, conditional on cross-domain constant transfer via RCMP).

kappa_definition.description: Centrifugal entropy score: ratio of mean multiscale entropy in hub parcels to that in peripheral parcels.

degree_ratio.description: Hub-to-periphery degree ratio computed from the weighted structural connectome using the same hub/periphery partition as for κ.

power_law_bridge.description: Bridge B1** (degree-heterogeneity formulation): κ scales as a power law of the hub-to-periphery degree ratio with exponent γ ≈ 0.55.

ceff_regime_transform.description: Cross-domain constant transfer: C_eff is fixed prior to neural analysis via regime transformation of the cosmological constant C.

key_results.main_finding: Replaces the λ2-based prediction with a degree-heterogeneity power-law (κ = Ceff · Dratio^γ), with γ constrained to 0.50–0.60 and Ceff fixed via RCMP; predictions are separated into Layer A (topological) and Layer B (absolute-scale).

sealed_predictions.statement: Across individuals, the centrifugal entropy score κ scales as a power law of the hub-to-periphery degree ratio: log κ = log Ceff + γ log Dratio with γ in [0.50, 0.60].
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Linear fit on log–log scale yields γ outside [0.50, 0.60] or cross-subject R^2 < 0.50 despite adequate SNR and matched hub/periphery partition.

sealed_predictions.statement: With Ceff fixed a priori by RCMP (no re-fitting on neural data), absolute κ values predicted by κ = Ceff · Dratio^γ lie within propagated uncertainty bounds across HCP-like datasets.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Mean absolute fractional error > 0.30 across subjects or systematic bias in residuals that cannot be removed by the prespecified secondary τc correction.

sealed_predictions.statement: Algebraic connectivity (λ2) does not outperform Dratio in explaining inter-subject variance in κ.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: In multiple independent datasets, λ2-based models consistently achieve higher R^2 than Dratio-based models for κ prediction under identical preprocessing and partitions.

sealed_predictions.statement: The τc contribution is a secondary correction O(τc/τH) that does not dominate κ variance.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: After applying the prespecified autocorrelation-based protocol, τc-related terms account for >30% of explained variance or are required to rescue otherwise invalid Layer A fits.

sealed_predictions.statement: Topological alignment holds: κ and Dratio computed with the same hub/periphery partition are robust to reasonable variations of hub/periphery thresholds.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Small, reasonable changes to hub/periphery thresholds (e.g., hubs 8–12%, periphery 25–35%) cause >25% swings in fitted γ or destroy the κ–Dratio scaling.

kill_criteria: KC1: Failure of Layer A scaling — Across well-powered, quality-controlled datasets, the κ–Dratio relationship on log–log scale yields γ outside [0.50, 0.60] or cross-subject R^2 < 0.50 with matched hub/periphery partitions.

KC2: Comparator reversal — Under identical preprocessing and partitions, λ2-based predictors consistently and significantly outperform Dratio-based models for κ across multiple datasets (e.g., ΔR^2 > 0.15 in favor of λ2).

KC3: Cross-domain anchor invalid — With Ceff fixed by RCMP, absolute κ predictions show mean absolute fractional error > 0.30 and systematic bias across independent datasets, not remediable by the prespecified τc correction.

KC4: Timescale dominance — The τc correction required to align predictions accounts for >30% of κ variance or is necessary to restore fits that otherwise fail KC1, contradicting its status as a secondary correction.

KC5: Partition fragility — Reasonable variations in hub/periphery thresholds (±2–3% around nominal 10% hubs and 30% periphery) produce unstable γ estimates or abolish the κ–Dratio scaling, indicating lack of topological alignment.

KC6: Non-reproducibility — The fitted γ (estimated once on a reference HCP sample) fails to generalize to held-out datasets from the same regime (cortex L1) with deviations >0.10 in slope without methodological explanation.

related_packages.role: Defines Bridge B1** and RCMP regime transformation used to fix Ceff.
Empirical grounding that degree heterogeneity explains variance in entropy/variability gradients.
Source of cosmological constant C used in cross-domain transfer.

abstract: Revised EFC-C framework introducing three falsifiable predictions grounded in the centrifugal entropy score kappa = <S_hub>/<S_periph>. Using Bridge B1*, kappa_healthy = C/(1 + lambda_2 * tau_c) where C = 4.4 from galactic dynamics. Extends to psychiatric populations via disorder-specific changes in structural connectome algebraic connectivity.

key_equations.delta_kappa: Delta_kappa = C * [1/(1 + lambda_2_h * tau_c) - 1/(1 + lambda_2_d * tau_c)]
